Bagaimana cara mulai menggunakan Disoriza?

Unduh Disoriza di Google Play, buka aplikasinya, lalu ikuti petunjuk untuk memindai atau mengunggah foto daun padi.

narrative.overview: A calm editorial guide for Indonesian rice farmers: generous whitespace, cream and sage surfaces, and Disoriza teal. Large sans-serif headings pair with italic serif emphasis; existing photography and real app screenshots make the product tangible. The user-selected Finzo layout is adapted directly in code while retaining Disoriza’s logo and identity.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet tonal sections with selective artwork shadows.
Indonesian copy and a clear Google Play action.
dos: Do retain the existing logo and Indonesian farmer-facing copy.
Do use real app screenshots and preserve their provenance in static/ASSETS.md.
Do preserve keyboard focus, the skip link, native disclosures, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don’t invent accuracy, ratings, adoption, or testimonials.
Don’t present promotional screenshots as a live analysis result.
